changelog: NEW: Guided Skeleton Builder (Pro) - place guides, build UE5 Mannequin or HumanIK-ready skeletons with mirroring, twist/IK/end joint toggles, templates and sockets. HumanIK naming auto-characterizes in Maya. NEW: Control Naming in Curves - auto-name controls from the selected joint. NEW: Orient to World. Apply to Selected for curve size and orientation. Fixed Sphere and Pin shapes. Responsive layout, collapsible Rig sections.
